messages:
jordan_acme: hey team — starting ~2026-03-15T07:10Z our mobile clients started getting a lot of 429s in prod. user reports + internal alerts. sample req id: r-abc123. can you triage?

alex_support: on it. can you confirm if any Retry-After or rate headers are present? also paste a reproducer curl if you have one.

jordan_acme: no Retry-After seen. headers sometimes show X-RateLimit-Limit: 1200RPM and X-RateLimit-Remaining: 0. example reproducer:
```
curl -v -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"gptx-large-q4","max_tokens":4000,"input":"summarize..."}' \
  https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate
```

priya_engineer: quick checklist to narrow root cause: 1) are requests arriving in tight bursts (clients spiking requests)? 2) are responses token-heavy (TPM can hit before RPM) 3) any client-side retry loops without jitter? 4) observe per-org concurrency.

sam_oncall: pulling gateway logs now. I see many requests from a handful of IPs at ~8-12 reqs/sec bursts for short windows. Also per-request token counts spike ~3500–4200 tokens which will push TPM.

alex_support: short-term mitigations to tell customer: add exponential backoff + jitter, cap client concurrency (eg 2 concurrent requests), reduce max_tokens to 512 or enable streaming, and ensure retries respect Retry-After header. We can also issue a temporary emergency rate increase if needed.

priya_engineer: for engineering triage please share one full gateway log line for a 429 event and the corresponding request_id (you gave r-abc123). We'll map it to model-instance metrics (queue length, token emit rate) for 07:05–07:20 UTC.

jordan_acme: paste of log snippet for r-abc123: [gateway] 2026-03-15T07:12:11Z req=r-abc123 ip=34.56.78.90 user=acme-cust status=429 reason=rate_limit bytes=4821 tokens=3982

sam_oncall: correlated metrics: queue_latency jumped to 380ms at 07:12 and worker_token_rate_limit tripped on model "gptx-large-q4". Per-model TPM counters show a cliff at 07:11–07:13.

priya_engineer: probable root cause: hitting token-per-minute (TPM) limits due to synchronized client bursts producing token storms. RPM looked OK because requests were brief but token emission per request was high. Recommended changes:
- client: cap max_tokens and split/stream long outputs
- SDK: add jittered exponential backoff and concurrency limits
- platform: consider rolling 60s window smoothing or allow short burst buffers for trusted orgs

alex_support: action items / owner matrix:
- Support (alex_support): communicate mitigation steps to customer and ask for client patch (ETA target 30m).
- Eng (priya_engineer): investigate smoothing the TPM accounting window to reduce cliff behavior and check model config for token-rate throttles.
- Ops (sam_oncall): prepare temporary per-org burst allowance option and impact checklist; ready to flip if PM approves.

jordan_acme: thanks — we'll push a client patch to cap max_tokens=512 and add jittered retries. ETA ~25m.

ratebot: System: rate-limit-override ticket created RB-4567 by alex_support — emergency +15% token window for org acme-cust for 1h pending review.

sam_oncall: update: after customer's client changes traffic smoothed around 07:40 UTC; 429 count dropped ~92% in our next 30m window. Keeping monitoring for 24h and will close if stable.

priya_engineer: follow-ups for product: consider documenting guidance for token-surge patterns (client-side caps, streaming, batching), and add an SDK default of max_concurrency=2 for mobile.

alex_support: closing note to customer: if you need a guaranteed higher sustained throughput we can discuss Dedicated or Reserved capacity to avoid shared TPM constraints. ping me if you want a quick runbook. :thumbsup:
